svg.title: Deployed AWS Orders API architecture
svg.desc: Client authenticates with Amazon Cognito, then sends JWT-authorized requests through AWS WAF to API Gateway. POST invokes Lambda to write to DynamoDB. GET queries DynamoDB directly. CloudWatch monitors API and Lambda metrics and X-Ray traces Lambda.
svg.text: Live GET bypasses Lambda and queries DynamoDB directly. DAX and API Gateway caching are template-only and were not deployed.
AWS architecture icons: official AWS icon set (Q1 2022)
